title: Oracle query tape window
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a type, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. If cell $r$ of its query tape is blank, then for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p$ and $p\le |Q|$, where $Q$ is the query string of $c$, changing the query tape content at cell $-1$ to blank makes its content at $p$ equal to the buffer tape storing $Q$ at $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes
the query-tape cell at $r$ is blank
